indication: weight management adjunct to reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity
population: adults with BMI >=30 kg/m2 or BMI >=27 kg/m2 with at least one weight-related comorbidity
outcome: estimated treatment difference in percent body-weight change
source: Wilding et al. Once-Weekly Semaglutide in Adults with Overweight or Obesity. NEJM 2021
transferability_to_germany: limited: multinational RCT population and intervention can inform efficacy context but not German real-world effectiveness
transferability_to_gkv: low for economic modelling: no German GKV utilization cost or savings endpoint
limitation: Trial excludes diabetes; lifestyle intervention in both arms; 68-week efficacy does not establish long-term outcomes or economic savings
permitted_use: clinical efficacy context for the defined semaglutide 2.4 mg non-diabetes scope only
